name: Canaria-Systems-S2-learned-compiler-streaming-v1

source_learned_object.experiment: G7 fresh confirmatory progressive 4->3->2 compact result

s2a.purpose: original learned compact model functional equivalence
s2a.chunking: resident shell plus two separately serialized learned compiler blocks; streamed mode reuses one CausalBlock module and never materializes both compiler blocks simultaneously
s2a.test_set: fixed G7 test set from committed reproduction runner

s2b.purpose: RSS amplification harness using only already learned compiler block states
s2b.sequence: repeat learned block0, block1 alternation 2048 times
s2b.full_resident: torch.load each logical chunk into an independent state_dict, retain all, touch every tensor
s2b.streaming: torch.load one logical chunk, touch tensors, release before next logical chunk
s2b.pass_rule: payload_streaming peak RSS delta < 0.20 * payload_full_resident peak RSS delta
s2b.interpretation: measurement amplification only; not a 4096-block trained model and no task-utility claim

global_boundaries: does not strengthen scientific compositional-generalization claim
does not demonstrate a particular MCU/mobile/edge deployment
if exact locked environment is unavailable, record ENVIRONMENT_MISMATCH rather than silently changing versions
